title: Data Connections
seo: Connect AI to your own business data
meta: Link AI to your documents, store or database so its answers come from your own facts. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Data connections that keep AI answers accurate
overview: AI gives better answers when it can read your own facts. We connect it to the places your information lives, such as help articles, PDFs, product feeds, spreadsheets or a database. We clean the content, split it into searchable pieces, set up a refresh so changes appear, and control who can see what. Answers can point back to their source, so your team can check them.

faq: Websites you own, PDFs, Google Docs, spreadsheets, Notion pages, help centers, product feeds and most databases. If a system has an API or an export, we can usually read it. Tell us what you use in the form.
Yes. We tag each source with who may see it and filter answers to match. A customer-facing assistant never reads files marked staff only, and we test this with sample questions before handover.
We flag conflicts during clean-up and ask you which is right. We cannot know your intent, so we do not guess. Out-of-date files are the most common cause of wrong answers, and we list them for you.
Do you move my data to another system?
Only a searchable copy is stored for the AI to read, in a service under your own account. Your original files stay where they are, and you can delete the copy at any time.
